verdict.rationale: Chargebee documents its own asynchronous Export API, which returns a download URL to a zip/pdf of the exported data. Its REST API also returns JSON, which allows programmatic extraction. However, the evidence does not show that exports cover all data, and it does not name open formats such as CSV inside the zip. Exit or offboarding guidance is also absent. Missing for 10: proof of complete all-data export coverage, explicit open-format (e.g., CSV) documentation for export contents, account exit/migration guidance, independent hands-on corroboration.
